items.name: hyperframes-suite
items.description: HyperFrames video skills with the CLI, Chromium and FFmpeg provided by the platform.
items.note: The hyperframes CLI, Chromium and FFmpeg are provided by the platform on PATH, and all HyperFrames skills in this pack are already installed and release-managed. Do not run `npx hyperframes skills update`, `skills check`, `npx skills add`, `hyperframes upgrade`, `browser ensure` or any npm install for HyperFrames; when a skill asks you to install or refresh a workflow, read the bundled skill of that name instead. Use `hyperframes` from PATH, not `npx hyperframes`. Run in the project directory inside the workspace; if `init` reports a permission error, run `chmod -R u+w` on the new project and continue. Workflows not in this pack (captions, talking-head recut, music-to-video, PR and Figma videos) are not provided. Keep the other upstream task instructions.
